scientific_integrity: The argument includes a uniform finite-case-free Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé strategy, a complete one-point and two-point atomic-type table, and explicit separating rank-three sentences. Finite checks corroborate but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Simple zero-divisor graphs of binary finite-product Boolean rings with at least two factors; pure adjacency and equality only; quantifier rank three only; no higher-rank, nonbinary-field, infinite-ring or ring-language classification is claimed. Historical priority not exhaustively certified.
title: Three-round collapse of Boolean-ring zero-divisor graphs at four factors
